name: Transition
overview: Scripture teaches that transition is a time to trust wholly in the Lord rather than our own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 encourages. In moments of change, we are commanded to be strong and courageous, knowing God is always with us (Joshua 1:9). The promise of God’s good plans for our future (Jeremiah 29:11) assures us that the end of a process is better than its beginning, calling for patient endurance (Ecclesiastes 7:8). Through prayer and thanksgiving, we can bring our concerns to God (Philippians 4:6), confident in the unchanging nature of Jesus Christ who remains constant through all seasons (Hebrews 13:8).
